title: 税改影响有限？：香港保单竞争力，依然在线
speaker: Stephen Lam

segments.en: The purpose is not to affect tax. If the argument of putting this tax on offshore insurance policies, then what about the onshore policies?
segments.zh: 目的不是影响税收。如果对离岸保障产品征税，那么内地产品呢？

segments.en: That would be the first question I asked myself, right? At the moment, insurance policies returns or the payout are not tax.
segments.zh: 这是我问自己的第一个问题。目前，保障产品的回报或赔付不征税。

segments.en: That's where we are at right now. So we can debate how they, why China is doing this, right?
segments.zh: 这就是现状。我们可以讨论中国为何这样做。

segments.en: But clearly, you know, we need to look at the facts, right? What can they actually do, and what is actually going to impact, right?
segments.zh: 但显然，我们需要看事实，他们实际能做什么，实际影响是什么。

segments.en: Right? Yeah. That is our question. Yeah.
segments.zh: 对吧？是的，这就是我们的问题。

segments.en: And we're trying to figure out, because again, they're trying to plug many different loopholes and many different ways.
segments.zh: 我们试图弄清楚，因为他们试图堵住许多不同的漏洞。

segments.en: I mean, you're saying it's not tax evasion, but clearly the Chinese authorities want to bridge this yawning budget deficit.
segments.zh: 你说不是逃税，但显然中国当局想弥补巨大的预算缺口。

segments.en: They also want to stem what they see to be excessive or illicit cross-border flows. We've seen a number of different steps.
segments.zh: 他们还希望遏制他们认为过度的或非法的跨境资金流动。我们已经看到许多不同措施。

segments.en: We've seen the crackdown on the brokerages. We've seen sort of an attempt to crack down on trust structures that have been popular with the ultra wealthy.
segments.zh: 我们看到对券商的监管，也看到对超富人群流行的信托结构的限制尝试。

segments.en: I've had lunch with a senior banker here in Hong Kong who brought me to lunch to ask me what's going on. How do we deal with this?
segments.zh: 我曾与香港一位资深银行家共进午餐，他问我发生了什么，我们该如何应对。

segments.en: Because they're trying to figure this out. And I agree with you, Stephen. This is serious when wealth management has been such a big part of the bank's profits.
segments.zh: 因为他们试图弄清楚。我同意你的看法，Stephen。当财富管理成为银行利润的重要部分时，这很严重。

segments.en: You mentioned some of those numbers of the banks. HSBC's fastest growing wealth business with fee income, these life insurance policies, fee income, up 21% in the second half.
segments.zh: 你提到一些银行数据。汇丰增长最快的财富业务，费用收入，这些保障产品的费用收入，下半年增长了21%。
